frontend_smoke.evidence: Incremental in-app Browser offline smoke for the homepage technical-SEO image update at desktop 1440x1000 and mobile 390x844. The 1672x941 WebP loaded successfully, the rendered page kept one H1, the mobile navigation stayed hidden, no horizontal overflow appeared, and there were no console warnings/errors. Browser-read JSON-LD resolved both WebPage and Product image fields to the same production WebP; automated tests separately validate the image sitemap entry. The localhost log contained only local page/asset GETs with no API request. This metadata-only change does not alter the previously verified preview, checkout, or paid-page behaviors. This digest invalidates the evidence on later frontend changes.

paid_flow_e2e.evidence: Narrow digest waiver for a measurement-only Worker change that does not alter checkout creation, payment verification, paid-answer submission, webhook handling, queueing, report generation, Resend delivery, or any customer response. The protected-source change is confined to GET /api/admin/growth-metrics: after the existing complete-commerce validation, it now rejects funnel RPC rows outside the requested closed-day range and rejects an exact duplicate attribution cohort before aggregation, returning HTTP 502 instead of emitting double-counted or out-of-range funnel truth. Identifier-free tests cover both rejection cases; the existing golden fixture still requires identical Worker/adapter range, goal/streak, totals, days, and attribution. All 9 Worker measurement/privacy/auth tests and the complete 34-test Node suite pass. No Lemon Squeezy transaction, webhook, report, or email was created; production payment/email E2E remains separately unauthorized, so this waiver is SKIPPED evidence rather than deployment or fulfillment proof. Any later paid-flow digest change invalidates this waiver.
